arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm.

8000 m, 6.4 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Calibration: pod CP 191 W, W prime 18.6 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Plan: settle to about sustainable shaft power (~195-200 W) after the hard start, even effort, slightly more into the current legs; check legs() to compare directions; watch for drag incidents (speed drop at same pod power, push_local falling) and instrument drift (pod vs boat power diverging); final push from about 1000 m to go if reserve allows, finish cue around 400-500 m.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: drag or current?

arguments.text: 1.0 min: hard start, shaft 259 W vs CP 191, pod reserve 79 pct. Cued ease to 151 pace. Watches set: reserve_low, drag_drop, too_hard, too_easy.

text: Cued ease to 151 pace after the hard start; set plan, note and four watches (reserve, drag, too hard, too easy).

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Long smooth strokes, 2:32 pace.
4.0 min: shaft 216 W vs sustainable 195, pod reserve 48 pct falling ~9 pct/min, boat reserve 40. Cued ease to 152 ground pace. If reserve keeps falling fast, ease again at ~5.5 min.

arguments.reason: check whether the ease took hold and reserve stopped falling

text: Cued ease to 152 pace: shaft power still above sustainable and reserve draining fast.

arguments.text: 5.6 min: settled. Shaft 197 W vs sustainable 195, pod reserve 42 pct, boat reserve 34. Leg 1 (north) push_along +0.06. Hold this; compare leg 2 (south) in legs().

text: no cue: the ease took hold, shaft power now at sustainable (197 vs 195 W).

arguments.text: Great work. Bank it, just a hair easier, 2:33.

arguments.message: pod reserve near empty yet paddler still above CP: CP may be underestimated, check fade

arguments.text: 8.6 min: shaft crept back to 204 W (sust 194), pod reserve 30 pct, falling ~5 pct/min. Paddler says 5/10, plenty. Possible CP underestimate but unproven; cued ease to 153. Leg1 out 212 W 3.41 m/s push +0.12; leg2 back 204 W 3.29 push +0.01. Current small. If reserve near 0 but no fade, raise CP via set_critical_power.

text: Cued gentle ease to 153 pace: shaft 204 W above sustainable 194 with pod reserve at 30 pct; added a watch for evidence that CP is underestimated.
